description.value: A full-service oceanfront resort on Vancouver Island with cliffside glamping tents, oceanfront cabins, a marina, and a restaurant — the tent option is luxury glamping rather than basic camping, so expect premium pricing but full amenities in a striking coastal setting.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Brown's Bay Resort is an active seaside resort on Vancouver Island offering cabins, glamping tents, and 60 full-service RV concrete sites, plus a marina and on-site restaurant — directly supporting camping and food amenities. Reservations are confirmed via a prominent 'Book Now' call-to-action and dedicated reservation phone numbers on the website. A phone number discrepancy exists: OSM lists +1-800-620-6739 while the website prominently shows 250-287-7108 (reservations) and 250-286-3135 (marina); the website value is used as the current contact.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-800-620-6739 but website prominently displays 250-287-7108 (reservations) and 250-286-3135 (marina). Website numbers used as current; OSM toll-free number should be verified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active seaside resort with RV/camping sites, on-site food, and marina on Vancouver Island — a useful and well-equipped stop for touring cyclists on this route.

wow_evidence: cliffside glamping tents, oceanfront cabins, a marina, and a restaurant
